findings.title: Gallery/Studio code runner isolation is not a security sandbox
findings.risk: Remote snippets execute as a child Node process with the application working directory and inherited environment. The source-text blocklist is not an isolation boundary; optional authentication and default-enabled execution materially increase exposure.
findings.doc0Action: Record only. Do not redesign Gallery/Studio execution during baseline phase.
findings.recommendedOwner: DOC-7 / DOC-8 with release-security review before public untrusted execution
findings.preservationConstraint: Any hardening must preserve verified Gallery/Studio authoring workflows while changing the execution trust boundary deliberately.
